orderingIssues: The same six screens are restyled twice or three times. Look restyles ranks, rank-up, workout, streak and recover in Phase 0. Vessel restyles ranks and rank-up again in Phase 1 (with a 128 px hexagon against Look's 64 px, and Body.rankShot figures). Train restyles the workout again in Phase 2a (name at 44 px against Look's ~40 px), and Recover restyles Recover and Streak again. Pick one owner: Phase 0 does every pure-look change, and later phases only add data slots (fade and flag tags, kinetic chips, fuel tags), leaving room for them as Look suggests.

The shader colour change has two plans. Look edits the rkC literals in place in Phase 0; 3D replaces rkC with a uRkC uniform read from tokens (the Body FX foundation). Do the uRkC version once in Phase 0, together with the FX hook, the compile-fallback and context-loss handling, so Phase 1's red pulse and Phase 3's aura start from it. Otherwise the fragment-shader string gets edited by four phases.

The Phase 1 kinetic-chain table (83 rows, a judgement call) blocks Phase 1 and Phase 2's Kinetic chain map, so it has to be in Andrej's hands early. Deliver it as a review table at the end of Phase 0, merged with Train's EXI tags (type, kit, pattern, canonical primary for the 8 dual-listed lifts) into one data deliverable, not two in different phases.

Data capture should start in Phase 1, not Phases 2 and 5. Add S.workouts[i].{t,end,ex,rp}, S.lifts[i].p and S.tally (lifetime count, region days, best e1RM) to Phase 1's finishWorkout change, and fix sessionsN at the same time. Retention windows (60 days, 90 sessions, 20 per lift) mean every week of delay loses history that trophies, rep density and the recovery nudge need.

Left/right must be settled at the very start of Phase 1, with a one-sided test flag shown on screen, before S.vul's side field and the injury UI are built. The mappers disagree (see the conflicts), and the display convention (anatomical or mirrored) is a product question.

Run two risky geometry spikes early (Phase 1 timeframe, behind a preview flag): the lotus or seated Monk pose, and the per-vertex muscle weights for the Tank/Scout morph. Their screenshots decide the Phase 3 and Phase 5 designs.

The currency decision (one XP or separate; GRIT; whether Learn XP gets renamed) is needed before Phase 3. Focus defines Neural XP, Phase 5 trophies and the card read it, and Phase 6's '+50 GRIT' depends on it. Settle it in the Phase 0 Q&A.

Native batching. Native wants build 9 at the end of Phase 2; Recover wants the native batch at the end of Phase 4. Build 9 must contain every native item later phases rely on: location and weather (Phase 6), keep-awake and the bg event (Phase 3 Monk), haptic styles (Phase 3 heartbeat), the notification sound (Monk), widgets v3 (needs final rank colours, Phase 1), the splash, the camera-string fix and the Android notification colour. That means the Phase 6 weather source and the Phase 3 native extras must be decided before Phase 2 ends. Also, Expo Go can't show HealthKit, RevenueCat or widgets, so the Phase 3 bio-rhythm RHR and Phase 5 Vault prices can only be checked on a TestFlight build. Plan a build after Phase 5 or accept checking them only in the release candidate.

The Body FX 'bodyStage' helper (keeping the 3D stage visible under a new screen) is needed by Phase 1 (injury map), Phase 3 (aura, Monk, bio-rhythm) and Phase 5 (Ideal Self, prestige). Build it in Phase 1 with the injury map. Vessel's setTab('body') overlay and Focus's see-through Mind panel are two ad-hoc alternatives.
Phase 6 weather dares could ship earlier than planned (they are small), but they are gated by a licence decision and by build 9. Decide the weather source in the Phase 0 Q&A, not in Phase 6.

The Vault restyle with today's real Pro perks is a pure look change on the existing paywall, which also shows in onboarding. Do it in Phase 0 so onboarding doesn't show the old paywall for five phases; only Pro materials wait for Phase 5.
Phase 7 depends on the app-name and version decisions (screenshots, subtitle, ASC version) and on the 8 Oct rejection reason being read in App Store Connect. Ask for both now, not at Phase 7.

Holding 1.0 until Phase 7, with no expo-updates, means months without a release and every fix needs a binary. The phase plan should show where a shippable 1.0 could be cut (for example after Phase 1 or 2).
crossAreaConflicts: Flag state shape. 3D proposes S.vuln = [{id:'m:<key>'|'j:<key>', side:'l'|'r'|'b', from, to}]. Vessel proposes S.vul = [{id, t:'m'|'j', side:'l'|'r'|null, at, off}]. They have different field names, side encodings and id formats. Pick one, owned by Phase 1's vessel.js.
Left/right. 3D says +x is anatomical left (correct by the camera maths and the heart at x=+0.03). Vessel's uVul codes 2 = right (x>0) and 3 = left are inverted.

Shader plumbing for flags. 3D uses a packed uFx[23] vec4 (x vuln-left, y vuln-right, z material, w inflate), uJnt[14], uRkC[6] and uFxT, injected through window.BODY_FX, with a 30 fps gate. Vessel uses separate uVul[N], uVJ[6] and uVulK, reuses the uSysB.w clock, and has a ~20 fps gate. Two incompatible designs for the same FS string.

Fade in rank mode. 3D: lvl*=1-0.75*fd plus dither or static. Vessel: mix(heat, grey, fd×.75) and lvl×(1−.5×fd). Pause maths: 3D uses pausedDays from S.vuln via JOINTS[j].reg (regions). Vessel uses vxIdle from S.vul via a new JOINTS[j].m (muscle lists). Different granularity for 'which muscles a knee flag pauses'.

Kinetic weights. Vessel converts SEC in place to {muscle:w} with secOf/kcOf/SEC_DEF and a vxCredit helper. Train expects SECW[name]={muscle:0..1} plus its own EXI[name].k canonical primary and exPrimary(). Evolve and Train refer to 'the Phase 1 shared gain function' under no agreed name. Vessel and Train both plan to edit train.js:175 (trTargets).

S.workouts additions are split across phases: Vessel adds rp:{}, Train adds ex:[{n,k,s,r,kg}] and t, Recover needs the workout end time, and Evolve keeps a separate S.tally. Define one entry shape in Phase 1.

Recovery nudge. Recover proposes S.recNudge {d,end,title,ks,at,snooze,n,done,off} plus S.resetOn, go:'reset', in recover.js. Native proposes S.nudge {on,at,ks,snoozed}, go:'flow', in native.js. Both wrap finishWorkout, remindPlan and nativeOpen, and their copy differs ('3 minutes for your chest' vs 'Your chest did the work').

Wrapper pile-up on the same functions. finishWorkout is edited in place by Vessel and wrapped by Train (density.js), Recover and Native, with Evolve wrapping drawDone. remindPlan is wrapped by Focus, Recover and Native; nativeOpen by Focus, Recover and Native; ossNotices by Look and Native; renderSys by Recover and Focus; stateOf, recoveredPct, hoursLeft and fadeOf are redeclared by Vessel and Recover. Recommend Phase 1 adds three small registries (onWorkoutDone hooks, REMIND_EXTRA providers, OPEN_ROUTES) and one owner file for the recovery and fade engine.

Currency. Focus has Neural XP stored on S.mind.log entries with S.neural {v,lv,seenLv}, keeps Learn XP separate, and renames Learn's to 'Learn level'. Native says no XP exists and proposes S.xp {total,log} or GRIT. Evolve uses RP for the path bonus and prestige laps. 'Level' already means three things: rank levels I/II/III, Learn Level N, and the proposed Aura Level 14.

Aura rendering. 3D puts a head rim in FS plus a BG_FS halo via injected chunks, driven by uNeural. Focus uses a separate WebGL canvas (aura.js) placed with Body.project, which means a second WebGL context alongside the body and possibly rdAlienMake.

Monk pose and stance. 3D uses MONK_SIT via Body.live (keeps rank colouring) and wraps figLive. Focus uses Body.startDemo({move:'monk_sit'}), which switches the FS to the ICE demo colouring (uDemoOn), inside the onboarding glass scene (obStart). Chest glow: 3D adds uHeart/uChest in the main FS branch; Focus reuses the onboarding-branch heart.

Heartbeat haptics. 3D: buzz(14) then buzz(8) after 210 ms at the RHR. Focus: buzz(14) then buzz(9) after 210 ms, tempo = RHR×(1+0.15×share recovering) clamped 48-80. Native: new 'haptic' rigid/soft styles about 120 ms apart via bridge v2.
Recovering colour. Look: tan #C5A059 as designed (the same as Stable). Recover: a separate token unlike any rank. 3D's AMB follows whichever is chosen.

Prestige. 3D: S.prestige[k]={n, mat, at} and Body.setMats(map); a whole-body skin goes in a new S.skin. Evolve: S.prestige[k]={lv, lap, mats[], mat, at}, Body.setMats(matIndex[]), and Pro materials stored in the existing S.finish via Body.setFinish.

Archetype. 3D: S.arch={path, since} and Body.setMorph({tank,scout}). Evolve: S.path={arch, at, next, n} and Body.setArch(arch, amount). Ideal Self: 3D Body.setGhost({on, inflate, colour}); Evolve Body.setGhost?.(targetScores).
Body capture. Vessel: Body.rankShot(yaw). 3D: Body.cardShot({w,h,yaw,…}). Evolve: Body.setRank(true) + Body.snapshot(). Train: Body.glowShot (demo colours).
Showing the 3D body under a new screen. 3D: bodyStage({cls,box,cam}) with a .bstage class. Vessel: setTab('body') with a 'panel u-own' overlay. Focus: making the opaque Mind panel see-through.
Dares ownership. Native moves the dare block out of ranks.js into a new dares.js and redefines dareToday. Evolve edits dareToday in ranks.js for the Tank/Scout mix.
Red token. Look: --danger becomes #FF3B30 with --alert aliasing it. Vessel: add --alert to replace --danger for flags. Train: red reserved for injury. Agree one name.
Native build timing. Native: build 9 at the end of Phase 2, release build 10 after Phase 6. Recover: one native batch at the end of Phase 4.

Neglect thresholds disagree: stateOf calls a muscle 'fading' at 7 days, the visual fade runs from 10 to 21 days, dares use 21 days, and Discovery's 'Neglected' reads stateOf. Phase 1 should set one rule.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: When you flag your left knee, should it appear on the figure's left (anatomical, as if facing another person) or on the side nearest your own left hand (mirror)?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: The model is symmetric and the code's 'R' labels mean the viewer's right. Today, +x on screen is the figure's anatomical left (the heart is drawn there). Injury flags make this visible for the first time.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Anatomical, which matches the heart already drawn on the figure's left. The text always names the side ('Left knee'). A one-sided test on screen comes first.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Should 'Vessel' appear in the app's wording (Vessel Engine, Vessel Vault, Vessel Trading Card)?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: The designs use it everywhere. Today's copy says 'your body' and 'Ossa Pro', and the App Store product is 'Ossa Pro'.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Keep 'Vessel' as an internal name only. The user sees 'your body', 'Your card' and 'Ossa Pro', with 'Vault' only as the label over materials.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Does 1.0 really wait for all seven phases, or can we cut a release earlier?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: There's no over-the-air updates (no expo-updates), so every fix needs a new build and review. Holding 1.0 for every phase means months with nothing live.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Ship 1.0 after Phase 1 (new look plus the Vessel Engine), then release the later phases as updates.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Add expo-updates in the native batch so later web-only changes can reach phones without a new binary?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: Today the web code is baked into each build. Over-the-air updates would let small fixes and phases ship faster, within Apple's rules for interpreted code.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Discuss before build 9. If yes, it goes in that build; if not, plan one build per release.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: One rule for which effects may move on the Body page?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: On 15 Oct you decided the Body page figure stays still. Three new effects want to move there: the injury pulse, the aura and fading. Moving effects also keep the phone drawing frames and use battery.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: The Body page stays still: a steady red tint, a still faint halo, and fading shown as a dimmed rank colour. Pulsing and shimmering only on their own screens.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Settle the currencies now: RP for muscles, XP for the Focus aura, and nothing new for dares?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: Learn already has XP and levels. The designs add aura XP, GRIT, RP and the '1.5× RP' perk, and 'Level' already means rank levels I-III and Learn levels.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: RP for muscles only. XP only for the Focus aura, with Learn's renamed 'Learn level'. No GRIT: dares count towards a trophy.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Should a backup of your current saved data be taken automatically the first time 2.0 opens?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: Everything lives only on the phone and there is no export. 2.0 changes the shape of saved data in several places, and the current loader silently starts fresh if saved data doesn't match.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Yes: a one-time silent copy on the phone, plus a hidden 'Restore pre-2.0 data' in Settings for TestFlight.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Phase 0's restyle: only the six designed screens, or every screen including onboarding, Mind/Breathe, Learn, the paywall and lessons?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: Tokens reach everything, but screens without a design (onboarding, Mind violets, lesson player) will look half-converted until someone looks at them.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Every screen gets the token, Inter and black pass with a screenshot sheet. Hand-tuning only for the six designed screens plus onboarding and the paywall.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Does Body Score stay in 2.0, and where?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: With RP, overall rank, aura XP and Learn XP, the four-pillar Body Score is a fifth number. The fuel plan changes its formula, and the card hides it by default.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Keep it, lower on the Body page, and leave it off the card and widget.

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Can store screenshots use 'Load demo data'?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: New screens (prestige, trophies, aura level 14) can't be reached by a real new user for months. Apple requires screenshots to show the real app.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Yes, with a better demo seed that stays plausible (no prestige in store shots unless it's reachable within weeks).

extraQuestionsForAndrej.question: Commit a git baseline before any change, and one commit per phase?
extraQuestionsForAndrej.why: web/, native/, docs/ and scripts/ are untracked, the shader edits are in place in an 11.9k-line file, and the only safety net so far has been folder copies.
extraQuestionsForAndrej.recommendation: Yes: a folder backup plus a git baseline, and a commit at the end of each phase (only when you say).

biggestRisks: One untracked 11.9k-line ossa.html with a single fragment shader edited by Phases 0, 1, 3 and 5. A single GLSL error on an iPhone (ANGLE/Metal is stricter than desktop Chrome) silently drops everyone to the flat 2D body (makeGLBody returns null, ossa.html:4507-4514). Mitigation: Phase 0 FX foundation with a plain-shader fallback, context-loss handling, a git baseline, and a phone check every phase.

Override mechanics. Redeclaring in web/ui any name that is a const or let in ossa.html (fadeOf, sessionsN, MOVES, RANKS, UI_TABS) is a SyntaxError that blanks the whole app. Hoisted redeclarations run at boot (TR at 5930) and hit TDZ on web/ui consts. IIFE wrappers don't run at boot. Six phases plan overlapping wrappers of finishWorkout, remindPlan, nativeOpen, stateOf/recoveredPct/fadeOf and renderSys, so registries and one owner per engine function are needed.

Saved-state loss. No schema version, a loader that resets to fresh if any SEED key is missing, a dozen new S fields from different files, and no backup. A bad migration or crash in an override at boot erases a user's only copy.

Shipping cadence. No expo-updates, 1.0 held for seven phases, every change needs a binary, and Expo Go can't test HealthKit, RevenueCat or widgets. Native needs from Phases 3-6 must be predicted before build 9.
Left/right inversion of injury flags. The mappers disagree; the code shows +x = anatomical left.

Legal and licensing. Open-Meteo's free tier is likely non-commercial (ground rule 4 may be wrong). Inter's OFL and the weather credit aren't in the licences screen. Selling materials breaks 'earned, never bought'. The camera permission string promises an unreachable feature.

Health-claim drift. Fuel 'speeds recovery' (a game rule on recoveredPct that changes every 'ready' time app-wide), a heartbeat tempo derived from resting heart rate, weight-based protein targets (13+ users), and the 'Sore spots' copy. All must stay game rules with plain disclaimers.

New palette legibility. Strong #FFFFFF equals the text colour and nearly the bone button and the 3D selection glow. Fragile #4A4A4A is about 2.1-2.4:1 on black. Tan 'recovering' equals Stable. Lime and gold are hard to tell apart for red-green colour-blind users.

Performance and battery. 5%-white glass blurred over a 30-60 fps WebGL canvas, continuous pulses, shimmer and heartbeat loops, and a possible second WebGL context for the aura on older iPhones during a 45-minute workout.

Privacy process. A mapper already sent part of Andrej's email to api.met.no in a User-Agent. Later work must keep identifiers out of every network request, and weather coordinates leaving the phone will change the App Privacy label.
